steps.name: admin-store-ownership-domain-schema
steps.summary: Canonical store_catalog domain/schema contracts were added with store-scoped OWNER/MANAGER membership, wallet/chain settings on StoreProfile, minimal StoreProduct fields, additive PostgreSQL tables, and CUSTOMER-compatible inventory audit role support.

steps.name: admin-store-ownership-provisioning-api
steps.summary: Admin-only createOrReuseStoreUser, createStore, and grantStoreMembership HTTP routes were added; provisioning reuses existing wallet identities, writes canonical store membership plus order/store-approval projections, and ignores client-provided role escalation.

steps.name: store-owner-product-registration-api
steps.summary: Store-owner product registration now authorizes by active store membership or ADMIN override and writes store_catalog_products, order_store_products, store_approval_products, and initial product_inventory consistently.

steps.name: ownership-authz-audit-idempotency
steps.summary: Catalog mutations and store-owner APIs require idempotency keys, detect same-key payload conflicts, record catalog/inventory audit context including store-scoped role, and allow CUSTOMER-role owners through membership checks.

steps.name: admin-store-catalog-public-verification
steps.summary: Public route docs, Postman expected responses, collection skeletons, local seed metadata, and phase metadata were updated for the 25-route admin store catalog and store-owner product registration surface.
